enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.

Fortification +100%: This suit of armor or shield produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer much more effectively. When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a 100% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.
Protection +7: Passive: +7 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.

Shield +6: While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +6 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.
Cold Resistance +40: Passive: +40 Enhancement bonus to your Cold Resistance.
This relic is attuned to heroic actions.
